title: Customer account creation
description: The system shall allow customers to create accounts to store customer profiles, configure contact information, view purchase history, and confirm orders.

A created customer account stores customer profile information.

title: Customer registration data collection, validation, and account creation

acceptance_criteria: During registration, the system prompts for first name, last name, billing address, shipping address, email address, and password.
The system validates the entered customer information before account creation.
Upon successful validation, the system creates a new customer account.
After account creation, the system displays an account home page to the customer.

System validates the customer's information.
System creates a new account for the Customer.

title: Customer account detail editing
description: The system shall verify changes and store new account information for a customer who is logged in on the system.
acceptance_criteria: Only a logged-in customer can initiate the Edit Account process.
When editing account details, the system verifies the submitted changes.
After verification, the system stores the new account information.

System verifies the changes.
System stores new account information.

title: Authenticate user with email and password

After successful verification, the system creates a session cookie.

System verifies the information.
System creates session cookie.
System displays account home page to the Customer.

title: Recognize customer's cookie and go to Step 5

acceptance_criteria: If the system recognizes the user's cookie, it does not prompt again for login credentials in that flow.
When a recognized cookie is present, the system proceeds to the account home page.
The recognized-cookie behavior is defined as an alternative login scenario.

Go to Step 5 (Basic Scenario).

After terminating the session cookie, the system displays the home page.

System displays the home page.

title: Define glossary entries for Data Dictionary, Data flow diagram, and Flowchart
description: The glossary shall define the terms Data Dictionary, Data flow diagram, and Flowchart.

verse: Data Dictionary: A collection of definitions for the data elements, structures, and attributes those are important to the problem domain.
Data flow diagram: An analysis model that depicts the processes, data collections, terminators, and flows among them that characterize the behavior of a business process or of a software system.
Flowchart: A model that shows the processing steps and decision points in the logic of a process or of a program, similar to that of an activity diagram.
